- Fetches 3 public lists using `getLimitedSharedLists`
- Shows a heading "Explore Public Lists" with a subtitle

- Uses the landing page theme (black background, white text)
- Only renders if there are shared lists available

The section appears before the footer and matches the rest of the landing page styling.
